scope: One private journal phase parse/encode occurrence and its actual staging/copies within the original operation/group/transaction/retention account; never an independent budget

counting.depth: Root object depth one; increment only object/array container nesting outside strings. Embedded artifact bytes are not JSON nesting.
counting.tokens: Reuse original custody token counting; raw JSON number nodes are additionally unsupported for the phase grammar and refuse after their bounded lexical observation. Refused tokens and duplicate members still charge actual work.
counting.members: Every object name/value member occurrence, including duplicates that later refuse.
counting.strings: Source bytes inside quotes including escape spellings; decoded text/UTF-8 and copied substring representations charged separately.
counting.work: Every scanned/decoded/hashed/copied/compared byte, member/token/lookup/allocation operation and uniqueness comparison; repeated parser passes and envelopes charge again.
counting.preflight: Read original source length and reserve complete selected materialization before allocation; bounded byte lexical scan precedes recursive native JSON parse. Unknown native detoast/parser scratch upper bound refuses this profile.
counting.aggregate: Minimum of applicable original row/operation/group/transaction/retention/phase caps and their remaining shared budget. Repeated calls or new phase names cannot reset work/allocation/deadline; unresolved custody remains reserved, spent work remains spent.
counting.deadline: Minimum stage/enclosing deadline from original invocation admission; preflight does not reset the clock. Native parsing must have selected actual cancellation/containment.
counting.maxima: Independent maxima do not promise simultaneous fit. A row total bound covers all original carriers, not a new 8 MiB entitlement for every carrier.
counting.sortRegeneration: Charge every member-name UTF-8 validation/sort comparison and byte visit, canonical output byte/allocation, original/regenerated equality comparison, full schema and native semantic traversal. Preserve domain-array order. Unknown sorting/parser/native copy upper bounds refuse before materialization.
counting.staging: Every start/transition/final/reserved/publication occurrence, original request/result, component wrapper/decoded byte and native/host/stage/cleanup copy charges its actual retained/working ledger. Identical hashes or bytes do not eliminate actual copies. The original parent carriers and separate immutable stages share capacity.
counting.phaseLifetime: Before capture and each growth/transition, prove complete original phase/stage obligations and at least one whole-operation cleanup cohort fit every enclosing selected limit. Never drop earlier transitions or split a group to fit the per-envelope ceiling. Unsupported maximum combinations remain explicit profile refusal, not a narrowed product support claim.

adoption: Select exact original phase codec/schema/native body/driver/staging/cleanup/account/build tuple; independently qualify original pre-materialization bounds, repeated phase passes, exact/one-over limits, cancellation/containment and whole-operation cleanup fit.
